counting_note: 50 confirmed findings, including linked failure modes; not 50 independent root causes. Distribution observations, dependency advisory records, static concerns and UX proposals are separate. Probe success means reproduction completed, not defect repaired.

repair_groups.title: Preserve export destinations and source identity
Persist settings and support advertised launch paths
Make library repair and persistence conservative
Preserve download intent and watch outcomes
Repair desktop lifecycle, layout and draft settings
Own reader and soundscape playback lifecycles
Repair audio installation, cancellation and LLM configuration

findings.title: filename collisions overwrite different stories; update staging can delete an unrelated book
findings.acceptance_check: Two works with identical title/author retain both files; updating a renamed export only replaces that exact target; requesting a different format preserves the original and correct extensions.

findings.title: ordinal chapter caches substitute old content after insertion/reordering
findings.acceptance_check: Warm-cache TOC insertion, deletion and reordering return each current source chapter once, in the requested order, with no stale body substitution.

findings.title: ScribbleHub TOC failure silently turns a recent-chapter excerpt into a complete book
findings.acceptance_check: Failed complete-TOC enumeration cannot produce or cache an artifact represented as a complete book; retry recovers the complete list.

findings.title: SubscribeStar CLI audiobook command raises NameError; its progress callback also has the wrong arity
findings.acceptance_check: The SubscribeStar audio CLI handler reaches a fake generator and accepts its real three-argument progress callback without an exception.

findings.title: merged SubscribeStar stories lose their source identity and cannot be updated correctly
findings.acceptance_check: Two merged works from one creator round-trip distinct stable source identities through export, index, update and reading/audio settings.

findings.title: Google Doc plain text is reinterpreted as HTML and loses literal content
findings.acceptance_check: Literal angle brackets, ampersands and quoted markup survive Google Doc text conversion as prose.

findings.title: newer sites are absent from the shared paste/clipboard story registry
findings.acceptance_check: Every supported scraper passes host detection, valid-story extraction, classification, canonicalization and export-source round-trip checks.

findings.title: declared Python 3.9 support fails at import
findings.acceptance_check: A clean install on the declared minimum Python version imports the CLI and completes a smoke export; unsupported versions are rejected by package metadata.

findings.title: the pip entry point rejects no arguments instead of opening the GUI
findings.acceptance_check: Console script, module and frozen entrypoints dispatch no arguments to the GUI, arguments to the CLI, and remain safe to import.

findings.title: deduplication discards deliberate exports to another format or folder
findings.acceptance_check: Same URL plus different requested output format or destination produces both artifacts; equivalent duplicate requests still share work.

findings.title: debug diagnostics write session cookies into logs
findings.acceptance_check: Synthetic session/authentication values never appear in diagnostic logs or exported reports, including response headers, URL queries and exception text.

findings.title: restoring the oldest retained backup deletes it before reading
findings.acceptance_check: Restoring any of ten retained snapshots succeeds without evicting the selected source before it is read, and preserves a pre-restore safety snapshot.

findings.title: a poll completion undoes concurrent user edits to a watch
findings.acceptance_check: Pause/label/channel/auto-download edits made while a poll is blocked survive completion; pending side effects honor current user configuration.

findings.title: failed auto-downloads are forgotten rather than retried
findings.acceptance_check: A failed auto-download remains pending and visibly failed across another poll and process restart; a successful retry retires only the failed item.

findings.title: notification failures silently consume the alert
findings.acceptance_check: Returned delivery failures are visible and retried per channel; successful channels are not duplicated, and cooldown does not discard pending updates.

findings.title: toggling autopoll off then on during a poll leaves it stopped
findings.acceptance_check: Off then on during a blocked poll leaves exactly one active polling worker after the blocked poll finishes.

findings.title: normal rescans erase manual adult and abandoned marks
findings.acceptance_check: Ordinary rescans preserve manual adult and abandoned state; explicit revival behavior is separately verified.

findings.title: doctor heals stale cache signatures without refreshing cached metadata
findings.acceptance_check: Healing a changed two-to-three-chapter file refreshes derived metadata before accepting its new signature; failed extraction remains invalidated.

findings.title: cache quarantine failures fall back to irreversible deletion
findings.acceptance_check: Two quarantines within one second retain both generations; an injected move failure preserves the source and is reported as failure.

findings.title: fresh watch downloads bypass the configured library and adult routing
findings.acceptance_check: Fresh story/author/search watch downloads resolve to configured main/adult library paths and become indexed; existing updates retain their exact targets.

findings.title: joining a successful GUI download reports auto-download failure
findings.acceptance_check: A watch joining a successful GUI download receives saved paths and a successful outcome; failed and cancelled results remain distinct.

findings.title: two first-time index writers silently overwrite one another
findings.acceptance_check: Two index instances loaded before first creation cannot silently lose either writer; also validate the intended GUI/CLI cross-process contract.

findings.title: malformed index files still crash recovery-facing consumers
findings.acceptance_check: Invalid UTF-8 and malformed nested index values produce a usable recovery state while preserving the original bytes.

findings.title: doctor drops a story even when an indexed duplicate still exists
findings.acceptance_check: Doctor promotes a surviving readable duplicate of a missing primary and preserves story metadata during the same repair pass.

findings.title: library template length limits count characters rather than filesystem bytes
findings.acceptance_check: CJK and other multibyte filenames fit the target filesystem component limit with extension/suffix reserved and collision-safe truncation.

findings.title: reorganization and removal leave stale full-text results
findings.acceptance_check: Move, remove, fresh export and rescan leave full-text results pointing at current existing files, with explicit stale/rebuild status on interruption.

findings.title: silent-edit scans reuse cached chapters and miss the edits they seek
findings.acceptance_check: A warm-cache silent-edit scan fetches current chapter bodies and detects a changed later chapter while retaining authentication and rate limiting.

findings.title: Linux source/pip preferences cannot persist because their filename is the data directory
findings.acceptance_check: Preferences survive a new settings instance and restart on native Linux; directory/file migration preserves settings and failed writes are surfaced.

findings.title: closing a search window leaves the application permanently busy
findings.acceptance_check: Closing a blocked search then completing its worker releases that operation; reopening remains usable and old completion cannot clear newer work.

findings.title: authentication fields collapse to zero height in the default Preferences dialog
findings.acceptance_check: Every credential field remains visible or keyboard-scrollable at default size, enlarged fonts and a small work area.

findings.title: default search windows clip filters horizontally
findings.acceptance_check: All site filters remain usable at default width and larger system text, with visual order matching keyboard order.

findings.title: library/watch jobs discard saved Cloudflare and newer site credentials
findings.acceptance_check: Manual, library-refresh and watch jobs receive the same configured CF solver and ScribbleHub/SubscribeStar credentials with intended precedence.

findings.title: fetching Audiobookshelf libraries freezes the desktop event loop
findings.acceptance_check: A slow or failed Audiobookshelf library fetch keeps UI timers/input responsive and cannot update a closed dialog.

findings.title: Cancel does not discard Audiobookshelf connection changes
findings.acceptance_check: Fetching libraries then cancelling leaves the saved URL/token and selections unchanged; OK commits a consistent draft configuration.

findings.title: Update File leaves a renamed book stale and writes a second book
findings.acceptance_check: Updating a renamed TXT/HTML/EPUB or a work whose upstream title changed replaces exactly the selected file and produces no unintended duplicate.

findings.title: the first-run manual directs users to controls that moved
findings.acceptance_check: The version-matched first-run guide leads a keyboard user from empty library through Add Story to the saved book; shortcuts and text-file versus web-list commands match the app.

findings.title: SMTP TLS never verifies the mail server certificate
findings.acceptance_check: SMTP_SSL and STARTTLS use certificate and hostname verification; an untrusted or wrong-host local certificate is rejected before authentication.

findings.title: Piper binary installation fails on nested Unix archives and then reports a directory as installed
findings.acceptance_check: Representative nested Unix and Windows Piper packages install to executable files; interrupted/failed installs are not reported healthy and can be repaired.

findings.title: local-only synthesis can silently send story text to Edge
findings.acceptance_check: With only a local provider enabled, failures invoke no cloud synthesizer and yield a visible error or an allowed local fallback.

findings.title: app voice ignores restored/bookmarked location and does not persist listening progress
findings.acceptance_check: Bookmark/resume/Stop/restart begin at the saved content position; listening progress survives reopen and periodic checkpointing limits crash loss.

findings.title: delayed voice resolution can restart speech after Stop or a mode switch
findings.acceptance_check: Queued voice-resolution/highlight/completion callbacks become inert after Stop, mode change, chapter change or close.

findings.title: incomplete audiobooks are reported successful and their missing speech is permanently cached
findings.acceptance_check: Failed segments or chapters cannot enter the complete audio cache or a complete-success result; a later retry restores all requested prose.

findings.title: cancellation is ignored during final assembly; preprocessing has no cancellation checkpoints
findings.acceptance_check: Cancellation during preprocessing, heading, intro or mux prevents a successful finished result and automatic upload; request boundaries honor cancellation.

findings.title: an obsolete soundscape build stops the newly selected soundscape
findings.acceptance_check: An obsolete blocked ambience build cannot stop handles owned by its replacement; close also cancels a not-yet-started build.

findings.title: failed LLM attribution is cached as a successful result and never retried
findings.acceptance_check: A provider/model attribution failure does not create a successful fallback cache entry; correction and retry work in the same process and after restart.

findings.title: choosing LLM speaker attribution does nothing unless unrelated note stripping is enabled
findings.acceptance_check: All four combinations of LLM attribution and LLM note stripping receive independent correct configuration and call only their selected backends.

findings.title: concurrent audiobook renders overwrite and clear each other's Cancel control
findings.acceptance_check: Completing render A does not clear render B cancellation; every active job remains individually cancellable or a documented Cancel-all cancels all.

findings.title: the live-TTS generation token does not prevent playback after Stop
findings.acceptance_check: A worker paused after its highlight callback cannot start playback after Stop returns or interfere with a replacement controller.

findings.title: naturally completed chapters leak live-TTS temporary audio when advancing
findings.acceptance_check: Natural completion followed by replay/advance/close disposes every previous controller and removes its temporary audio.

findings.title: reader selects the first installed voice regardless of enabled provider or language
findings.acceptance_check: Reader voice choice respects enabled providers and language, persists explicitly, and displays which provider will receive text.
